name: app-user-testing-results-table-with-heatmap-screens
title: User Testing Results with Tap Heatmaps
whatItIs: A pale grey slide titled User testing Result with a paragraph, a mission table with tasks, average time, success rate and completion in white capsule cells, and a row of pale banking screens overlaid with red-and-green tap heatmaps.
whatItMeans: Capsule cells make numbers stand out on a hairline table, and heatmaps make usability findings visual.
techniques: Values in white capsules on hairlines
Tap heatmaps drawn as red centres with green halos
Screens shown desaturated so the heat stands out
Large light title with a short paragraph
Row of screens cropped at the right edge

vocabulary.definition: A colour overlay showing where users tap or look most.
A number displayed inside a rounded white pill.
A list of test tasks with time and success metrics.
